name: Buckley Carlson
moments: He argues that a press office is 'an intelligence network': a deputy press secretary builds rapport with every journalist, as Buckley Carlson did before starting a consultancy, and Carlson's interview show does the same with influencers, who 'owe him a favor' and will never criticize him (he names Dave Smith, Candace Owens and Ryan Carroll). He calls it human intelligence and the Carlsons 'an intelligence family', then casts a 'heist' crew for 'this coup': Vance the face, Peter Thiel the money, Carlson the mouthpiece.

Answering Carlson's attacks in the Brandon Straka interview, he presents the 'lore dump' he posted on X: Carlson's nephew Charles works in Palantir's press office in the UK and used Reform party connections to sell Palantir to the British government; Buckley Carlson's wife's stepfather, Charles H. Price II, was Reagan's ambassador to the UK; Dick Carlson ran Voice of America, 'a CIA news outlet'; Carlson's son Buckley was Vance's deputy press secretary. He calls it 'a multigenerational press family' and says pointing it out is pattern recognition, not attacking their children.

He attacks Megyn Kelly, Tucker and Buckley Carlson as controlled opposition for telling young men to vote GOP, marry young and become plumbers, and says he is the one radicalizing the masses. He urges viewers to copy the DSA by joining Young Republicans, College Republicans, Turning Point and campaigns, then wraps early and says Iran is saved for tomorrow.

He argues there is a coordinated, CIA-linked effort by Tucker, Thiel and tech money to groom a base for Vance in 2028, and that Groypers are the obstacle, citing Joe Kent's loss and the Ohio race against Vivek Ramaswamy. He mocks Buckley Carlson's advice to get married young and become a plumber while the Carlsons take political jobs.

Reacting to Buckley Carlson attacking him on Twitter, he says he is constantly called a fed and turns it on the Carlson family: Dick Carlson at Voice of America, Buckley's wife's father a Reagan ambassador, a nephew at Palantir, and Tucker's ties to Peter Thiel, Vance and Joe Kent.

He attacks Hasan Piker and the Young Turks, says Tucker Carlson's left-right unity push with Hunter Biden is a charade, and says the left believes in its cause while the right keeps trying to be liked. He says Marjorie Taylor Greene and Tucker are courting people who hate them.
Hunter Biden wrote a letter of recommendation for Buckley Carlson to get into Georgetown. It doesn't get swampier than that
